This is a largehospital, but its management and service processes are relatively slow compared to other major hospitals in the same area. If you’re not in a hurry and can spare about two hours, it’s fine to use their services. However, if you need quicker service, it’s better to go to another hospital, as the quality of treatment, doctors, and pricing are essentially the same.

The worst service ever! The hospital called and said to come before 5:30 pm, your appointment is at 6pm. We reached before time and the now the doctor said they will come down by 7pm. It’s like they do not respect their patient! Time is valuable learn to respect people time! Very unprofessional!
Went to the emergency dept this morning. Very good, fast service. Excellent English speaking doctor. Only go if you have insurance, 4000 baht for a splinter pull.

I came to treat an ingrown nail, but the hospital quoted 8,000 THB for the procedure which is unreasonably expensive for such a minor treatment. My friend came here for an ultrasound and blood test and paid only around 3,xxx THB, so I really don’t understand how this small operation could cost more than that.

Moreover, the nurse at the surgical department was quite rude and unprofessional. When I mentioned that I had insurance, she told me it’s better to pay first, saying it would take 1–2 hours to check with insurance, but the way she spoke and looked at me felt very disrespectful. Actions speak louder than words; her attitude made me even more upset than the high price itself.

Overall, I decided not to proceed because of both the unreasonable cost and the poor service attitude.
